lanes.summary:
The diff satisfies all acceptance criteria for PMAT-437 (#437) and includes nothing forbidden or out of scope.

Key verifications:
1. `scripts/prepush_gates.sh` runs the pre-push quality gates (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --all-features`) disconnected from SSH before pushing, stamping the commit SHA in `$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/prepush-gates/<SHA>`. Stamping requires a clean tree matching HEAD.
2. `.githooks/pre-push` checks stdin for pushed refs:
   - Branch deletes (SHA `0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`) skip quality gates.
   - Stamped commits pass immediately without re-running tests inside the open SSH connection.
   - Unstamped commits run all three quality gates as before (using `scripts/prepush_gates.sh --run-gates` or inline fallback).
3. `scripts/prepush_gates.sh --self-test` provides a comprehensive 12-case test suite covering clean trees, unstamped refs, failing tests, dirty/untracked trees, and end-to-end hook integration with stubbed cargo calls.
4. The 4-line clippy fix (#438) for unnecessary borrows in `println!` macros across `streaming_token_generator.rs` and `autograd_custom_ops/main.rs` is properly included.
5. Shell scripts pass `bash -n` and `shellcheck -S error`.
